input.summary: Cap early termination charges at three months' charges in Section 3.4(b).
input.comment: [Playbook] Our convenience exit in Section 3.4 is otherwise acceptable, but the early termination charges in 3.4(b) are open-ended; we have capped them at three months' charges, consistent with our fallback position on early-termination fees.

ops.oldText: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments.
ops.newText: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments, not to exceed three (3) months' charges.
